{{Top}}
A '''neurotoxin''', also known as a '''neuro poison''',<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars Battlefront II: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Battlefront II'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> was any form of [[Poison/Legends|chemical]] that affected a victim's [[nervous system]] and targeted neural components, oftentimes destroying them. The [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[King/Legends|King]] [[Sebolto]]'s drug cartel added neurotoxins to the [[Bando Gora/Legends|Bando Gora's]] [[Death stick/Legends|death sticks]], which made them more potent and addictive.<ref name="DP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>

The [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuard]] could release a neuro poison cloud in its immediate radius that was toxic to [[Species/Legends|organic lifeforms]] and had a crippling effect.<ref name="Prima" />
